name: Verdict101
title: Verdict101
description:
Every business story has an official version. We read the documents.

Business collapses don’t happen overnight. Corporate frauds don’t start in one boardroom meeting. Billion-dollar failures aren’t caused by one bad decision. But someone, somewhere, made the call that made everything else inevitable — and that moment almost never makes it into the coverage.

VERDICT is a business documentary channel that goes beyond the headline. Every episode investigates a corporate collapse, boardroom coup, business model, or power structure using primary sources: SEC filings, court depositions, internal memos, and the earnings calls most people never listen to. We don’t tell you what happened. We show you why it was unavoidable — and name the exact moment the outcome was sealed.

New episodes every Tuesday. If you’ve ever watched a business documentary and felt like you were getting the PR version — this channel is the alternative.
